description: Skill triggering set for askit-migrate: verifies the skill fires on foreign-repo adoption, conformance-gap assessment, bring-to-conformance planning, and cross-agent migration, and stays silent on greenfield plugin creation, conformance audits of already-gradeable plugins, and individual skill improvement.

assess this repo's conformance gap against the Standard
produce a bring-to-conformance plan for this skills repository
adopt this foreign skills library into my plugin ecosystem
write the minimal library.json so this repo becomes gradeable
migrate my Claude-only plugin so it also works with Codex
plan the Bronze-to-Silver upgrade path for my existing plugin
this repo was built without the Standard, help me get it into shape
map what exists in this ad-hoc repo to the Standard's component types
I inherited a skills repo, what is it missing for Bronze
produce a staged roadmap to get this repo to Silver
write a root AGENTS.md for this repo so anatomy passes
assess the gap between my current plugin and the Gold tier
this repo was built before the Standard existed, bring it into conformance
start a new plugin from scratch
scaffold a new plugin with the full Bronze anatomy, I have no code yet
create a plugin from scratch and onboard me through the structure
onboard a new maintainer through a plugin scaffolding interview
run a conformance check on my plugin
